Inde Navarrette Previews Rogue’s Iconic Catchphrase for Upcoming Marvel Cinematic Universe X-Men Reboot

First Look at the Accent

Actress Inde Navarrette has offered fans an early preview of her vocal approach to the character Rogue in the upcoming Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) X-Men reboot. During a red carpet interview with the Canadian news program Etalk, the Obsession star was asked by a reporter to deliver Rogue's signature catchphrase, "sugar."

Responding with a smile, Navarrette offered an initial take on the line. "You know what? God bless me, I haven’t done a lot of practice. But, ah! I mean, my version’s just, ‘Sugar,’" she said. She added that she plans to refine the performance further, noting, "I think that, you know, I’m gonna work on it, if you don’t like it, and I’m gonna figure out and talk to the Marvel team on what we wanna do."

Joining the MCU Cast

Marvel officially announced Navarrette’s casting in the upcoming X-Men project during an appearance at D23 earlier this year. She is part of an ensemble cast attached to the reboot, which includes Sadie Sink as Jean Grey, Kit Connor as Cyclops, Christopher Abbott as Professor X, Samara Weaving as Emma Frost, Maya Boyd as Storm, Asa Germann as Angel, and Adam Driver as Mr. Sinister.

The film will be directed by Jake Schreier and is currently scheduled for theatrical release on May 5, 2028.

Speaking about the role on a recent episode of The Hollywood Reporter’s Awards Chatter podcast, Navarrette expressed enthusiasm for stepping into the franchise. "I also recognize that with acting comes the freedom of being a completely different person, one of those people being Rogue, Anna Marie… paying homage, paying respect to the incredible writers that are a part of Marvel, with Jake Schreier directing, taking what they want to do, adding my own sauce, and then going from there!"

In Marvel Comics history, Rogue—whose real name is Anna Marie and who hails from Mississippi—possesses the ability to temporarily absorb the powers, memories, and physical traits of others through skin-to-skin contact.

Practical Implications and Verification

Readers interested in verifying the original casting announcements, interviews, and release details can consult the reporting from [The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/inde-navarrette-rogue-southern-accent-x-men-film-1236739602/).

What Is Confirmed vs. Unknown

  • Confirmed: Inde Navarrette has been cast as Rogue in the upcoming MCU X-Men reboot directed by Jake Schreier. The film has a scheduled release date of May 5, 2028. The actress previewed a casual version of the character's signature catchphrase during an Etalk carpet interview and discussed her preparation on the Awards Chatter podcast.
  • Unknown: Specific details regarding plot lines, costume design, the full extent of the mutant lineup, and how closely the film adaptation will follow specific comic book storylines remain undisclosed by Marvel Studios.
